# Silk Ride — London's Premier Luxury Chauffeur Service

> Premium chauffeur service in London offering luxury airport transfers, executive car hire, wedding transport, and corporate travel. Mercedes fleet with professional drivers, available 24/7. Phone: +44 203 488 2324 · Email: info@silkride.co.uk · Rated 5.0/5 on Google (24 reviews).

Silk Ride Ltd is a licensed private hire operator based in London, United Kingdom, serving London, the UK and Europe, 24/7, 365 days a year. All vehicles are Mercedes-Benz with leather interiors, climate control, complimentary Wi-Fi, phone chargers and bottled water. Fixed, transparent pricing with no hidden fees. Payment: Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank transfer.

## Services

- [Airport Transfers](https://silkride.co.uk/services/airport-transfers): Meet & greet, real-time flight tracking, 60 min free waiting (international) / 45 min (domestic)
- [Heathrow Airport](https://silkride.co.uk/airport-transfers/heathrow): From £120 to Central London
- [Gatwick Airport](https://silkride.co.uk/airport-transfers/gatwick): From £180
- [Stansted Airport](https://silkride.co.uk/airport-transfers/stansted): From £200
- [Luton Airport](https://silkride.co.uk/airport-transfers/luton): From £200
- [Hourly Chauffeur Hire](https://silkride.co.uk/services/hourly-chauffeur): From £50/hour, 4-hour minimum, as-directed service
- [Corporate Travel](https://silkride.co.uk/services/corporate-travel): Executive transport for meetings and roadshows
- [Wedding Chauffeur](https://silkride.co.uk/services/wedding-chauffeur): Luxury wedding cars with ribbons and champagne service
- [Event Transport](https://silkride.co.uk/services/event-chauffeur): VIP transport for concerts, galas, theatre and sport
- [UK & Europe Travel](https://silkride.co.uk/services/uk-europe-travel): Long-distance chauffeur-driven journeys
